what: Five About cards sit in a WebGL fan arrangement at the bottom of the screen (center card x .5, y .19, sides .66/.34, .27 and .78/.22, .39, tilt 0, ∓18°, ∓23°, scale .9, .84, .8). On each event, that card rises from .12 lower, .88 scale and transparent over .527s power3.out. On finish, the cards exit upward in sequence, delayed by (.04 + .11i)/1.1s with .255s power2.in, fading out, and the whole plane blurs 8px (.655s power2.inOut) — an intro where cards stack one by one as the menu points at each category.
